query:
SELECT 
  i.id as intake_id, i.sponsorId, i.submittedAt,
  s.companyName, s.contactEmail, s.contactName
FROM intakeSubmissions i
JOIN sponsors s ON i.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.contactEmail = 'bobby@recruitmentevents.co'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  r.id as rankings_id, r.sponsorId, r.submittedAt,
  s.companyName, s.contactEmail, s.contactName
FROM rankingsSubmissions r
JOIN sponsors s ON r.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.contactEmail = 'bobby@recruitmentevents.co';
